title: knowledge(testing): license-entitlement failures on posted tables in a SaaS test run are environmental
summary: A testing knowledge article explains how to triage and fix license-entitlement failures on posted tables in SaaS test runs, distinguishing them from permission regressions and recommending data production through posting APIs.
key_points: Identifies license-entitlement failures as environmental, not permission or code issues
Documents that TestPermissions=Disabled and SUPER permission sets cannot lift license checks
Recommends producing posted data via test library posting codeunits instead of direct inserts
Provides good and bad code samples showing the distinction
Mirrors the app-side security knowledge about not granting rights beyond entitlements
